decisions.OQ-A907-11: local matching network on/immediately adjacent to the ICP module; chain = RF generator -> directional coupler -> 50-ohm line -> local match -> antenna; the off-platform-match + long unmatched coax arrangement is no longer the A9 baseline (supersedes that part of the A9.1 A9-03 'matching network location' clarification)
decisions.rf_measurement_reference: forward/reflected power measured on the generator/50-ohm side of the local match; retain P_forward, P_reflected, |Gamma|, VSWR and where possible P_delivered = P_forward - P_reflected - P_line/match,loss; never assume P_forward = P_plasma
decisions.rf_500W: 0-500 W is a laboratory delivered/operating investigation capability, not a component rating; generator, coupler, coax, connectors, matching elements, feedthroughs selected only after the mismatch envelope is characterized
decisions.rf_protection: reflected-power monitoring, mismatch/interlock threshold, arc detection where feasible, thermal monitoring, automatic RF reduction/shutdown; trip thresholds frozen after antenna/load characterization, not invented now
decisions.icp_matching_strategy: adjustable local matching network for the development article; flight implementation (fixed / switched / electronically tuned / other) only after Z_antenna = R + jX is measured vs mdot, P_RF, p, gas composition, Hall operating point
decisions.anode_316L: 316L no longer the flight/design baseline for the H-1 anode (allowed as engineering/shakedown, coupon candidate, low-temperature development component); do not select W, Mo, Pt etc. merely for melting point
decisions.anode_approach: ANODE_BASELINE = OPEN; design blockers for anode material AND anode heat-removal path; investigate conduction to backplate, support/feed-tube conduction, heat spreading, radiative area, coupling to spacecraft/stand, deposited power fraction, refractory/oxidation-resistant candidates, active cooling only if passive fails; objective = reduce operating temperature, then T_operating <= T_validated,continuous - 50 K; no new arbitrary anode limit
decisions.icp_coupled_thermal: ICP_COUPLED_THERMAL = UNRESOLVED until the model includes Q_Hall->ICP, Q_collector, Q_RF/match, Q_plume and the ICP assembly's geometric effect on H-1 radiation; no thermal PASS from a negligible-coupling calculation
decisions.radiative_view_requirement: ICP mechanical design carries a radiative-view-factor objective (open-frame support, minimum obstruction, annular/open optical path, thermally isolated mounting, high-emittance outward surfaces, Hall-to-ICP axial spacing); not optimized for compactness alone
decisions.13W_pole_allowance: design-driving warning; not grounds to reject A9; assuming ICP thermal interaction is negligible is prohibited; coupled view-factor/conduction calculation required before thermal closure
decisions.coil_mass_correction: ~0.14 kg = copper for the 60 W / fixed-ampere-turn sensitivity basis, not the MC-1 coil mass; ~1.58 kg may remain the estimated complete-coil copper mass from H2-1 sizing; never alternative estimates of the same mass; A9-06 closure uses only clearly defined complete hardware mass
decisions.a9_10: may continue; incorporate the statuses and blockers; purpose is to make the unresolved state explicit, never to force closure
decisions.pr_33: keep DRAFT; after A9-10 merges: full suite, golden, integrity, historical immutable hashes, complete A9 diff review, confirm A9-10 records the RF/anode/thermal blockers; only then convert to ready for final merge review
post_a9_priorities: P1 ICP electron-source bench: I_e(P_RF, Z, p, mdot, gas), prove ICP-45
P2 ICP impedance map: Z_antenna = f(P_RF, mdot, p, gas, plasma state)
P3 coupled thermal redesign with actual downstream ICP geometry/view factors
P4 anode design: conductive/radiative path, candidate-material trade
